subject: AWS Marketplace metering / entitlement / invoice flow - procurement checklist
messages:
From: Emma Lopez <emma@procureops.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procureops-pm@procureops.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing - metering, entitlement & invoicing questions

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Procurement at ProcureOps asked me to follow up with a couple of concrete questions so we can close POs and get the SaaS listing enabled in our AWS Marketplace account. Can you confirm the following?

1) Invoice flow: Will Redwood issue invoices directly to ProcureOps or do we get billed via AWS Marketplace (consolidated billing)? If via AWS, what is the expected invoice lag / settlement window?

2) Entitlements: We need a per-tenant entitlement model (seat-based for our users) surfaced to our billing system. Can you confirm the SKU mapping and whether you support entitlement webhook callbacks for license revocation?

3) Metering: For trial/free-tier usage, how do you report usage to AWS? Do trial calls count toward our entitlement until we flip to billable?

4) Evidence: Our security team also requested an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II and an implementation SOW for metering/fulfillment. Could you attach those?

Best,
Emma Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager
ProcureOps Inc.

--
Attachment: procurement-question-list.txt

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@procureops.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - metering, entitlement & invoicing questions

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (finance), Marissa (integration/ops), and Karthik (partner / marketplace) so we can answer each item. Short answers up front:

- Invoice flow: We support both direct invoicing and AWS Marketplace billing (via metered usage or subscription license). For Marketplace SaaS licenses customers can choose to have charges flow through AWS (settled monthly by AWS) or accept invoices from Redwood under a reseller arrangement.
- Entitlements: We can publish per-account SKUs and provide entitlement webhooks (push to your endpoint) and on-demand entitlement checks via our API.
- Metering: Trial calls are flagged as "trial" usage and will not be reported as billable to AWS unless you opt-in to convert the tenant; we can automate conversion on first paid seat.

Kimberly/Marissa/Karthik — can you please confirm: a) expected AWS settlement windows we should surface to customer, b) which SKU ID(s) we'll publish for ProcureOps, and c) who will send the SOW + SOC2 doc? I attached a draft SOW and SOC2 placeholder for procurement review.

Thanks — Rishi
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: SaaS_Metering_SOW_v2.pdf, SOC2-Type2-2024.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Emma Lopez <emma@procureops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - metering, entitlement & invoicing questions

Hi Emma — happy to confirm details from finance.

- Settlement & invoicing: If ProcureOps elects AWS Marketplace billing (metered or SaaS subscription), AWS issues consolidated invoices to ProcureOps and pays Redwood per AWS settlement windows. Typical settlement timing: AWS closes usage each UTC month and payments to sellers occur on a ~30-45 day lag depending on the contract and any reserve. We recommend budgeting a 45-day receivable lag for Marketplace flows. If you prefer Redwood invoicing directly, our standard Net30 applies.

- Taxes: We'll need a W-9 (US) or equivalent tax form prior to direct invoicing. For Marketplace flow, AWS handles tax remittance per their marketplace terms.

- Billing identifier: For Marketplace billing we will publish a SKU ID (we will confirm exact SKU soon). For direct invoices, please provide a remit-to and PO number once you are ready.

I'll attach the SOW and SOC2 to this thread (sent with Rishi). Let me know if ProcureOps needs anything redacted on the SOC2.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: SOC2-Type2-2024.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma@procureops.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - metering, entitlement & invoicing questions

Emma / team — quick technical notes from Integration/Ops for entitlements and metering: 

- SKU mapping: We'll publish two SKUs: PROCUROPS_SEAT_MONTHLY_v1 (seat license) and PROCUROPS_TRIAL_v1 (trial wrapper). We will push entitlement events (activate/deactivate) via POST to a ProcureOps endpoint at the event cadence you choose (immediate or batched).
- Webhooks: Entitlement webhook payload includes: customer_id, sku_id, seats_active, effective_at, signature (HMAC). We'll provide sample delivery and retries (exponential backoff) in the SOW.
- Metering reporting: For metered endpoints we report usage records to AWS per-hour; trial flags are set and will not be marked billable unless the tenant is converted. Conversion can be manual or via your billing webhook (we accept an "accept_terms" callback).

Action items for ProcureOps:
- Provide a test webhook URL for entitlement callbacks (we can send sample events to verify signature).
- Confirm whether you want immediate delivery or batched delivery.
- Provide PO / remit info if choosing direct invoicing.

I'll include sample payloads in the attached SOW. If you want we can schedule a 30-min tech sync this week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Ops, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: SaaS_Metering_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Emma Lopez <emma@procureops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing - metering, entitlement & invoicing questions

Thanks all — that's very helpful. A couple of clarifications and next steps from our side: 

1) We'll take Marketplace billing route initially (to keep procurement simple). Please confirm the SKU IDs when published and we will reference them in our internal catalog.
2) Entitlement webhook: we'll stand up a test endpoint for ProcureOps sandbox (https://sandbox.procureops.com/entitlement/test) and prefer immediate delivery. Expect a separate email from our infra team with IP allowlist details.
3) SOC2: thanks for sharing — security wants the full report under NDA. I'll route a DocuSign NDA to Rishi and Kimberly; once executed we need the SOC2 PDF redacted only for vendor-specific logs.
4) Can we schedule the tech sync tomorrow at 9am PT? Our solution engineer Sam will join. 

If that works I'll raise the PO once we have SKU confirmation and the DocuSign NDA is in place.

Best,
Emma Lopez
ProcureOps Inc.
